quest.79DF019CB23EC414.title: &5Enter the Otherside
quest.79DF019CB23EC414.quest_subtitle: Step 穿过 the gateway beyond the Deep Dark.
quest.79DF019CB23EC414.quest_desc: &7Activate a portal made of &3Reinforced Echo Shards&7 和 step into the &5Otherside&7 dimension.
&7This twisted realm is a corrupted End — floating sculk islands, glowing geodes 和 ancient ruins, 所有 watched over by the &c监守者's&7 echo.
&c警告:&r Once you enter, &dShriekers&7 will activate faster. Carry &f羊毛 boots&7 和 never sprint.
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.title: &5Otherside Survivor
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.quest_subtitle: Spend real time 内部 the Otherside.
quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.quest_desc: &7Prove you can live 和 breathe in the &5Otherside&7 — 不 只是 visit it.
&7Set up a safe base, source food (sculk-tainted 怪物 drop edible meat), 和 farm &3Echo&7 和 &3Sculk Crystals&7 for endgame gear.
&e提示:&r &d监守者 Heart&7 grows 这里 — protect it 从 despawning to harvest the &8Soul Elytra&7.
quest.5FFE4ACE65F45C83.title: &3深渊群系
quest.5FFE4ACE65F45C83.quest_desc: &7The &5Otherside&7 隐藏 four distinct biomes — find them 所有 to map the dimension.
&7探索 the &3Echoing Forest&7, the &8Blooming Caverns&7, the &5Otherside Vegetation&7 fields 和 the &fOvergrown Caverns&7. 每个 biome has 独特 flora, 怪物 和 resources.
&e提示:&r 使用 a &6Compass of the Lost&7 to ping 附近 unexplored biomes.
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.title: &dAncient Structure
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.quest_subtitle: 战利品 a forgotten Otherside ruin.
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.quest_desc: &7Track down an &dAncient City Outpost&7 或 &dOtherside Temple&7 hidden in the dimension.
&7These structures 按住 &6Echo Chests&7 与 sculk-themed loot: &dSculk Catalyst Cores&7, ancient music discs 和 pre-enchanted Soul Tools.
&c警告:&r 大多数 structures spawn &dShriekers&7 — break them 与 &eSilk Touch&7 之前 scavenging.
quest.3C4ECF5741837953.title: &3猎人:溺尸&r
quest.3C4ECF5741837953.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: 斩杀 &e溺尸&r in rivers, oceans 和 ruined portals.
掉落 include &fRotten Flesh&r, &bNautilus Shells&r 和 rarely &eTridents&r.
quest.599FA8D2FBA2725D.title: &3猎人: 溺尸 Elite&r
quest.599FA8D2FBA2725D.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: Continue thinning the &e溺尸&r population — focus 在 &cTrident-wielders&r.
&eLooting III&r dramatically 增加 &fTrident&r 掉落.
quest.4005DA1BA51C0C68.title: &f猎人: 恶魂&r
quest.4005DA1BA51C0C68.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: 击杀 &fGhasts&r in the &cNether&r — particularly in the &7Nether Wastes&r 和 &8Soul Sand Valley&r.
Reflect their &cfireballs&r 用一个 &fsword&r 或 &fpunch&r for an easy kill.
掉落 &f恶魂 Tears&r (used in &dRegeneration potions&r) 和 &eGunpowder&r.
quest.0B6950F705B589CC.title: &6猎人: 乌姆乌塔纳&r
quest.0B6950F705B589CC.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: 猎杀 &e乌姆乌塔纳&r tribe 从 &dMowzie's Mobs&r — found in &esavanna&r biomes 周围 their totems.
&cBeware&r: they hunt in packs 和 call reinforcements 从 their &6乌姆乌提 Chieftain&r.
掉落 &e乌姆乌塔纳 Masks&r — wearable trophies 与 独特 effects.
quest.47B80CE376D06676.title: &5猎人: Troll&r
quest.47B80CE376D06676.quest_desc: &aBounty&r: 斩杀 &dTrolls&r in the &5Twilight Forest&r — they roam &eHighland caves&r near &cTroll Caves&r structures.
&cTrolls hit hard&r 和 have heavy &fknockback resistance&r — bring &b钻石&r 或 &5下界合金&r gear.
掉落 &eMagic Beans&r used to grow giant beanstalks toward sky structures.
